title: Four Peaks Guided Off‑Road UTV Adventure
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This off‑road adventure explores the Four Peaks Wilderness in Tonto National Forest, passing Saguaro Lake before entering the sandy desert rolls through the Pobrecito access point. The route climbs through giant boulders, towering cactus, smooth rock formations, and wide desert washes. Wildlife such as wild horses, coyotes, javelina, and snakes are often seen. Temperatures at the summit are much cooler than Phoenix, and winter months may bring snow, so a jacket is recommended. We are the only tour company offering this exclusive route, guided by licensed U.S. Forest Service operators with annual CPR certification. Vehicles carry emergency supplies, a Starlink Mini for communication, and cooling misters for comfort on warm days. Guests receive saguaro cactus seeds as a parting gift, and optional stickers or patches are available to remember your adventure.
